listing_info.listing_name: The Historic Ambrose House
listing_info.description:
Nestled in the Lakes Region, our charming 19th-century home offers a unique getaway. Imagine unwinding amidst farms and hiking trails, with Lake Winnipesaukee and the majestic Castle in the Clouds just minutes away.

This pet-friendly haven has welcomed travelers for two centuries, blending historic charm and modern comfort. Whether you seek relaxation or adventure, our home provides the perfect base. Create lasting memories and feel the echoes of generations past within these welcoming walls.

The space
The perfect jumping-off point for Bike Week, a tank away staycation / microstay, or a lakes and mountains adventure. We hope you love this home as much as we do. Its convenient location offers a great location to explore all the lakes region has to offer.

The Ambrose House is situated in Moultonborough, NH at the foot of the Castle in the Clouds. The home dates to the early 19th century, and has served as a family farm, boarding house, and residence through the generations of occupants. The Ambrose family cemetery, now part of town land, is on the northeast corner of the property and includes the Revolutionary War soldier, Captain Nathaniel Ambrose.

The home is comfortably appointed to make your stay welcoming. Two bedrooms downstairs, and two upstairs provide sleeping for up to 8 people. The enclosed porch is a great place to enjoy your morning coffee, or for children to play with the toys we provide. Multiple bookshelves in the home are filled with a variety of books for all interests and ages. An office space and WIFI give digital nomads a place to stay productive. If games are your thing, you will find a large selection under the living room TV.

The kitchen is well-stocked with pots and pans, baking sheets, utensils, dinnerware & silverware, and tools. The centerpiece is an antique stove converted to propane, but guests can also use the wall oven, microwave, induction cooktop, and toaster. Morning coffee rituals can be satisfied with an espresso maker, drip coffee pot, moka pot, Keurig, electric kettle, and coffee grinder. An assortment of teas are also in the drawer in front of the coffee station. We provide essentials like salt and pepper. Finally, the well water is delicious, and shares the same source as Geyser Peak bottled water.

The first floor of the attached barn includes fun activities like yard games, foosball, ping pong, and a Pac-Man arcade game.

The property has a spacious backyard with a fire pit and Adirondack chairs, and the apple and pear trees provide fruit in the fall for your enjoyment. The fenced-in side yard includes space for pets to stretch their legs in safety. A new deck with table and chairs and a gas grill provides opportunities to cook, dine, and relax outside. A hot tub is situated with privacy from the road and neighbor.

Our neighbors have a farm--their farmstand across the street is open during the growing months and provides the freshest farm-to-table experience imaginable.

Moultonborough hosts two town beaches on Lake Winnipesaukee, and a beach pass to park is located in the drawer under the printer.

Traveling with small children?
In addition to the children’s corner on the sun porch full of toys and books, there is also a pack n play and full-sized high chair in the barn for your use. We also have a baby gate on the sun porch and some outlet covers in the drawer under the printer.

Traveling with Pets?
Dog bowls and mat are all in the bottom shelf of the pantry in front of the sink. If you need a crate you will find both a large and small one in the barn. The deck door has a doggie door if your pets are used to using one. There is a bag of dog toys by the slider and a dog house in the fenced-in yard. We do ask that you clean up after your pets and provide a pooper scooper in the shed as well as doggie bags in the drawer to the right of the antique stove.

Traveling in an Electric Vehicle?
Charger is provided at no additional cost for a sustainable stay.

Guest access
You are welcome to explore our historic home. The first floor includes the kitchen, laundry, office space, enclosed porch, family room, 2 bedrooms, 1.5 baths, and yard & barn access. The second floor has two bedrooms. The basement is not intended for guest access.

The historic barn's first floor is available for guest use and includes ping pong, foosball, Pacman arcade, and lawn games. Garbage barrels for bagged trash are in the first stall.

Back yard has a fire pit, Adirondack chairs, picnic table, apple & pear trees (help yourself to fruit in season), and a walking path. Please be aware of ticks in woods.

Fenced-in yard with dog house, propane grill, patio set, and hot tub for guest use. Shed is not intended for guest use. Rear security camera monitors door and front gate; hot tub is out of frame.

Other things to note
No parties or event, or unregistered guests. Please be respectful of our neighbors, who are farmers--early to bed, early to rise.

Please Take Note:

The property is located in the mountains and there is wildlife in the area. Since we are located in New Hampshire, you may find the occasional bug in the home, but we make every effort to minimize any encounters by having the the property treated by professionals on a quarterly basis.

listing_info.listing_name: Suissevale Getaway: Beach & Ice Castles! Sleeps 10
listing_info.description:
Welcome to the Game House, the ultimate Lake Winnipesaukee retreat & winter escape! Stroll to the private lake access for ice fishing/skating ⛸️, hop on nearby snowmobile trails, or drive to great skiing (Gunstock) & famous Ice Castles. Explore the exclusive game zone complete with foosball and rock wall! Prepare to unwind with s'mores and huddle around the firepit or around the indoor fireplace. Enjoy executive WiFi, personal gym, stocked kitchen & TWO KING bedrooms, +Queen Bedroom +loft.

The space
Expect crisp clean white linens, Scandinavian inspired curated design and a private home on a tranquil corner lot.

Enjoy the 2 King bedrooms, 1 Queen bedroom and loft with full bed, twin bed, and twin trundle to connect with friends and family. We even have an optional pack and play for a little one (please bring your own sheets for the pack n play).

Downstairs, get your workout on with dumbbells and a bench, mirror, and exercise ball to keep up your morning routine.

Connect with family in the game room with kids rock wall, foosball table, shuffle board, board games, book nook and 2 video game arcades.

Keep up with work with a dedicated workspace and executive speed wifi so you can extend your vacation as long as you'd like.

Walk to the nearby States Landing Beach to access ice fishing and snowmobiling, just a 10 minute walk from the house. In the winter, the lake becomes a playground with snowmobile trails nearby or snowmobile on the lake! There's even annual dog sledding! Try ice fishing, go snow shoeing, or just cozy up next to the outdoor fire or inside near the electric fireplace. In the summer, fish off the nearby dock or private association beach, or drop your boat in to explore all the lake has to offer.

Hike around Castle in the Clouds or head to Gunstock mountain resort for zip lining or skiing.

Enjoy coffee or a glass of wine on the outdoor sofa complete with string lights, or meander to the wraparound deck and laugh over a game of corn hole.

Feeling chilly? Warm up next to the indoor electric fireplace and enjoy the toasty central heating throughout our home.

Before dinner, venture to El Mariachi for a margurita, guacamole and chips. Or, if you're feeling adventurous, head to Wolfeboro for curated shops and waterfront dining.

Complete your night with dinner in nature using the fully stocked kitchen (bring your own spices / sauces) at the 8 seat outdoor dining table or indoor with seating for up to 10. Forgot something? Pop down the road to Starley's for anything you've forgotten, or pick up fresh, doughy pizza from Anika's down the way for a hassle-free night.

Head up to bed for a slumber party in the loft, or escape to your 3 private bedrooms with brand new mattresses including 2 King bed options.

Before bed, be sure to gaze up from the loft through the skylights and see the magic of all the stars.

Guest access
Enjoy access to the entire property (upstairs, main level, downstairs game room, wraparound deck, 0.5 acre property) with the exception of a few owner's and housekeeping closets and the garage which are locked.

There is parking for 4 vehicles and boat parking.

Other things to note
Please note, the private association beach is open to our home guests Fall through Spring, and in Summer on Sundays - Fridays.

Dogs are allowed but we are highly allergic to cats and cannot accept them. Dogs are not allowed on the furniture especially not on the leather couches and beds.

This home is great for gatherings, but absolutely NO parties, NO events are allowed with no exceptions. Our neighborhood is very pristine and expects quiet hours 10pm until 8am.

We hope you enjoy your stay and fall in love with the quiet relaxation the lake and nearby mountains have to offer.

listing_info.listing_name: Funky Lake House
listing_info.description:
Have fun with the whole family at this stylish place. Close to the lake and stocked with everything you need to have a great time. Great game room with Air Hockey, Darts and Ms PAC-Man
Also we have a 21ft Seadoo Ponton Boat with a Capt. to take you around the lake. Let me know if you want to reserve this fun adventure.

The space
Newly purchased 1600 sq ft home and remodeled with new appliances and brand new kitchen and bathroom. Kitchen is fully stocked complete with everything you will need. Beds are top notch memory foam mattresses. Quality sheets, blankets and pillows. As a renter I knew what I wanted for my space so I went all out. A king bed, queen bed 2 sets of bunk beds one trundle. Toddler bed, pack and play with mattress. Also 2 sleep sofa’s that are full size.
Outside is a gazebo with furniture and a gas grill and cooler.
There is a fire pit in the yard for s’mores. Plenty of beach chairs and a wagon to haul your beach gear to the lake. Tennis rackets and basketball along with a paddle boat and life jackets.

Guest access
You will have the entire home on spacious wooded lot to yourself.

Balmoral has a private boat launch and day dock. Simply launch your boat and pull it up on the beach for a day of fun. On the beach there are ample picnic tables and a swim area and swim dock.

WE CAN OFFER A PONTOON BOAT TRIP WITH A CAPTAIN JUST ASK FOR DETAILS.

listing_info.listing_name: Dream Family Lakeside Getaway
listing_info.description:
Escape to our cozy, modern lake house on a scenic canal, comfortably sleeping 12 guests with 3 bedrooms, a bunk bed room, and 2.5 bathrooms. Enjoy our private dock and tranquil backyard with a fire pit and screened room. Take advantage of exclusive access to the community’s private beach, perfect for sunbathing and swimming. With nearby boating, fishing, and hiking, our home is the ideal base for your Lake Winnipesaukee adventure. Book today for unforgettable memories!

The space
Escape to our cozy yet modern lake house, nestled on a scenic canal leading to the breathtaking Lake Winnipesaukee.

This spacious retreat:

- Comfortably sleeps up to 12 guests
- Features three private bedrooms
- Boasts an unforgettable custom bunk bed room with five additional beds
- Offers two and a half bathrooms
- And is perfect for family gatherings or friendly getaways.

Step outside to enjoy our private dock, where you can easily launch your boat or simply soak in the stunning views of the lake and canal. The backyard is a tranquil oasis, complete with a covered outdoor shower and a fire pit for evening s'mores and a screened room that invites you to relax with the sounds of nature.

The home’s interior exudes a cozy lake vibe, blending modern comfort with rustic charm. Gather in the open living area, cook up meals in the well-equipped kitchen, or unwind in one of the inviting bedrooms after a day of adventure.

Enjoy exclusive access to the community’s private beach, ideal for sunbathing, swimming, or picnicking. With plenty of nearby activities—boating, fishing, hiking, and exploring charming local shops—there's something for everyone to enjoy.

Whether you’re here for a peaceful retreat or action-packed adventure, our lake house is the perfect home base for your Lake Winnipesaukee experience. Book your stay today and create unforgettable memories!

listing_info.listing_name: A Beautiful mountain home with Amazing views
listing_info.description:
Enjoy this luxury home with breathtaking mountain views 3 miles from Lake Winnipesaukee and 3 miles from States Landing Beach.

The space
Welcome to Greatview!

A half mile driveway leads you up to a truly incredible property nestled at the foothills of the Ossipee Mountains. The renovated
home is essentially turn-key, featuring vaulted ceilings as it blends charming original details with tasteful decor. All of the finishes, textiles, and fixtures are elegant.

The master bedroom has a king bed, spacious closet, stunning views, and en suite bathroom. Upstairs, one bedroom has a king bed and a sleeper sofa that becomes a queen bed; it also has a spacious closet and stunning view. The third bedroom has two twin beds and a sleeper sofa that can become a full bed.

All of the bathrooms are renovated: the downstairs en suite master bathroom, the downstairs powder room, and the upstairs spa-like bathroom, which also houses the washer + dryer.

The full kitchen features gourmet appliances (six burner gas range, modern
dishwasher and refrigerator) and is fully stocked with everything a guest would need in a kitchen, including basic spices and olive oil. You will not need to bring anything besides food and beverages. Under a crystal chandelier, the dining table seats ten.

Upstairs, there is a sitting room that overlooks the main living room. In this peaceful loft there is a desk, vintage settee, a plush bench which can double as a twin bed, and a special reading nook (technically a "turret," a unique highlight of the home that a lucky kid may want to sleep in).

Outside the sliding glass doors, there is an in-ground pool and brand new hot tub. There is a variety of comfortable outdoor seating for both leisure and dining. All of the pool accessories can be found in the shed.

The 60 acre property also has a cabin! The cabin has electricity but no running water. There is a sleeper sofa in the cabin, making it an ideal space for lounging, reading, yoga, or meditation. Behind the cabin, you may follow a short trail to behold a 25 ft. waterfall feeding a stream. In addition, there is a hiking trail to the top of the mountain.

We know you will enjoy your stay!

Guest access
The entire house and cabin are available to guests.

listing_info.listing_name: Lake Winnipesaukee Beautiful 5 Bedroom / 6 Bath
listing_info.description:
Experience beautiful Lake Winnipesaukee w/ Mountain and Lake views in Balmoral. Steps from the private community beach and boat dock. Air conditioned 5 bedroom, 6 bath house with a deck off three master bedrooms w/ master baths. 70" flat screen in living room w/ internet + cable. All bedrooms have flat screens (65", 65", 55", 44", 40"). Hardwood floors throughout. The private community has tennis pickleball + basketball courts, volleyball, bocce, playground, beaches, and clubhouse. Enjoy!!

The space
Air conditioned 5 bedroom, 6 bath house with a deck off of the three master bedrooms w/ master baths. 70" flat screen in living room w/ internet + cable. All bedrooms have flat screens (65", 65", 55", 44", 40"). Hardwood floors throughout. Large spacious bedrooms, living room, and kitchen. Hardwood throughout the house, and a gas fireplace. Over 3,400 square-feet of living area.

Other things to note
Located in the esteemed Balmoral community, residents relish a plethora of amenities for an active lifestyle. With tennis, basketball, pickleball, and volleyball courts, plus a playground, there's something for everyone. Balmoral's crown jewel is its private sugar sand beach, spanning 500 feet, with a boat launch for Lake Winnipesaukee access. Whether boating, swimming, or relaxing by the water, this community offers it all. This property is an excellent opportunity, allowing you to capitalize on owning a slice of paradise. Surrounded by outdoor activities like golfing, hiking, and snowmobiling trails, Balmoral ensures endless entertainment.

Birch Hill 18 hole golf course & Castle in the Clouds are minutes away.

We have beach chairs, yard/beach games, kayak, firepit, gas grill on the back deck all for your personal use. We also have ping pong, board games for indoor use too. There is something fun to do for everyone.

Enjoy everything this home has to offer within the community; Beach, boating, tennis, pickleball, bocce, basketball, volleyball, playground or just relax. Enjoy the sandy waterfront, beautiful views of the lake and mountains.

listing_info.listing_name: Beautiful remodeled lake home.
listing_info.description:
Bring the whole family to this great home, with lots of room to spread out. The space
Single family home, with 3 bedrooms, 2 living spaces. Just renovated.

Lock box

listing_info.listing_name: Splendid Home in the Heart of the Lakes Region!
listing_info.description:
This home was new to the rental market Summer 2024. NEW beds, linens, and AC, with a well-appointed kitchen and updated furnishings. 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths. Airy open floorplan for conversation upstairs, TV room downstairs.

Enjoy our family home in the Suissevale community, just a short distance to the incredible Lake Winnipesaukee, with access to a private boat launch, beach, playground, tennis/ basketball courts, BBQ/picnic tables, and endless options to create memories!

The space
Large open concept upstairs living room, dining room, and kitchen with cathedral ceiling and gorgeous lighting. On the same floor are 2 large bedrooms (king bed in one, and full-sized bunk beds with queen bed in the other) and 1 full bath. Upstairs is the primary with large bedroom (king sized bed), walk-in closet, and full bathroom. Downstairs (ground level) is a generous TV room and game space.

For access to the lake, drive a quick 4 min (0.9 miles) to the beach! Parking pass provided upon check-in.

Enjoy a meshed in portion of the patio with lighting and table & chairs (4), great for avoiding the bugs. Additional seating is available on the rest of deck.

Washer/ dryer on-site. Beach towels provided- please leave the white towels for the home.

- Meredith: about 15 min away
- Laconia/ Weirs Beach: about 30 min away
- Castle in the Clouds: about 10 min away
- Deli/ gas station: about 5 min away
- Coffee/ Bakery: about 5 min away (and delicious)

Guest access
Guests have access to the entire property, except for the garage and a small owners closet on the ground floor.

Other things to note
The living space is on the second and third floors (garage and daylight basement/tv room on the ground floor) and therefore might not be suitable for all guests due to the stairs.

Ample parking in driveway for 2+ vehicles and/or a boat w/trailer. Private boat launch within the community. Must maintain guest pass for parking (provided for stay and must be returned before departure).

Children of all ages are welcome; however, the home is not child proofed.

AC comes from a mini split on main level and in the upstairs primary bedroom. Central fan (furnace) moves cool air thru house. Please use the mini split controllers to adjust AC temp. By changing the thermostat to cool/ heat, you’ll turn off the central fan and the home will heat up. Extra fans provided for extremely warm days where the mini split might not be sufficient.

We are not responsible for power outages, unsatisfactory weather, wildlife/bugs, or trip interruptions not covered by Airbnb’s Major Disruptive Events policy. Travel insurance is highly recommended. We cannot guarantee the cosmetic condition of the fixtures and furniture due to damages from other guests.

listing_info.listing_name: New Hampshire Lakes Region Home With Beach Access
listing_info.description:
Walk to the beach down the street, hike the trails/snow shoe at Castle in Clouds, or visit one of the ski resorts in the area. The house can comfortably sleep 6 with 2 queen beds and 2 twin beds. There are 2 full baths, a beautiful screened-in porch, patio, and a well stocked kitchen. Set in the lake community of Suissevale, the house is a short walk to States Landing beach/boat launch and about a mile from Suissevale beach. Castle in the Clouds hiking / snowshoeing trails are an 8 minute drive.

The space
Access to Suissevale amenities:
2 beaches, tennis courts, & playgrounds.

Set in the lake community of Suissevale, the house is a short walk to States Landing beach and boat launch and about a mile away from Suissevale beach.

Castle in the Clouds mansion and hiking/snowshoeing trails are an 8 minute drive.

The house is located within 45-60 minutes to several ski resorts.

The open concept floor plan has 3 bedrooms including a master suite with a bathroom.

There is another full bathroom for the other 2 bedrooms to use.

The kitchen is well stocked with essentials including a Keurig Duo Plus Single-Serve & Carafe Coffee Maker, electric kettle, toaster, microwave, crockpot, dishwasher, and a blender.

The 2 living areas, all three bedrooms, and screened-in porch have SmartTV's if you want to use your streaming services.

There is a washer and dryer located in the basement.

Enjoy the screened in porch, patio and fire pit in the yard. Patio furniture and a grill are available in the warmer months.

Guest access
Access to 1st floor (kitchen, dining, living room and bedroom areas), 2nd floor loft sitting area with 55" smart TV for streaming, screened porch and front deck with gas grill (weather permitting) and washer/dryer in the full basement.

Other things to note
Summer rules:
Suissevale association does not allow renters at the Suissevale beach on Saturdays (changeover day).

At all times guests are prohibited from beaching any jet skis or boats in the designated boat area on Suissevale Beach. This includes all days of the week, including Saturdays. The use of the designated boating area is reserved for Suissevale members only

There is a convenience store a 5-minute drive away and a larger grocery store in Center Harbor (15 min) and Meredith (25 min) away.

You can bring your kayaks or paddle boards and store them under the patio for your stay.

States Landing beach/boat launch is about 5 minute walk from the house.

We don't wear outdoor shoes in the house, and while we can't enforce the no-shoe policy, we'd appreciate if you leave the shoes at the door.

The thermostat is in the hallway. Please turn the dial to adjust the temperature to your liking.

Please note that the stove in the living room is decorative and not functional.
